title: HullQ ObservationApplicability
description: Structured applicability scope for an observation or evidence record. Preserves year/hull/market/variant/option/state/individual-hull restrictions where known. Unknown boundaries are normal and must not be interpreted as global or all-production applicability.

first_year.description: First production year this observation applies to. Null means unknown lower bound.

last_year.description: Last production year this observation applies to. Null means unknown upper bound.

hull_number_from.description: Hull serial number lower bound, inclusive. Null means unknown.

hull_number_to.description: Hull serial number upper bound, inclusive. Null means unknown.

market_or_region.description: Market or geographic region this observation applies to (e.g. US, EU). Null means unknown or global.

named_variant_hint.description: Named variant reference or hint where known (e.g. 'shoal draft', 'tall rig'). Not a canonical NamedVariant ID.

design_option_hints.description: Design option references or hints where known. Not canonical DesignOption IDs.

operating_state_hint.description: Operating state reference (e.g. 'mast up', 'mast down', 'loaded waterline'). Does not create a DesignOption.

individual_hull_or_listing_ref.description: Reference to a specific hull, listing or build where the observation applies only to that individual. Non-null means the observation is individual-hull scoped and must not project to BoatDesign baseline.

unknown_or_unbounded.description: True if the applicability scope is explicitly unknown or unbounded. Does not imply global or all-production applicability.
